sections.title: AI Services for San Francisco FinTech Organizations
sections.description: Consumer-first, mobile-native AI built specifically for San Francisco's FinTech ecosystem.

items.title: Consumer Credit and Alternative Lending AI
items.description: SF's consumer lending sector — personal loan platforms, BNPL providers, earned wage access companies, and alternative credit scoring startups — is the world's most active developer of ML-based credit models. Credit risk scoring with alternative data: ML models incorporating rent payment history, income data from bank account analysis, employment verification, and behavioral signals alongside traditional credit bureau features — enabling lending to underbanked populations that traditional credit scoring excludes. FCRA-compliant adverse action reasons: SHAP-based adverse action reason code generation for every credit decision, meeting CFPB and FCRA requirements for consumer credit. ECOA fair lending compliance: disparate impact testing across protected classes, prohibited variable screening, and consistent treatment documentation for CFPB and California DFPI examination. Underwriting automation: end-to-end automated underwriting workflows that process applications in seconds rather than hours. Cost: $55,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 14–24 weeks | FCRA, ECOA, CA DFPI compliance standard.
items.label: Consumer Credit

items.title: Payment Fraud Detection
items.description: SF's digital payments ecosystem — Stripe, Square (Block), Brex, Marqeta, and hundreds of payments infrastructure companies — requires real-time fraud detection at extremely low latency and high throughput. ML fraud models scoring transactions in milliseconds with the precision-recall tradeoff calibrated to minimize both fraud losses and false declines that damage merchant conversion. Cost: $55,000–$135,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | Real-time serving infrastructure standard.
items.label: Fraud Detection

items.title: Personal Finance and Wealth Tech AI

sections.title: California FinTech Regulatory Context
sections.description: San Francisco FinTech operates at the intersection of California, federal, and consumer-focused financial regulation.

items.title: California DFPI
items.description: The California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation regulates most SF FinTech operations — consumer lenders, money transmitters, and financial service providers. DFPI's approach to AI in financial services is evolving; ClickMasters designs with DFPI examination requirements in mind.
items.label: CA DFPI

items.title: CFPB
items.description: Federal Consumer Financial Protection Bureau oversight applies to SF's consumer lending, payments, and financial product companies — particularly FCRA adverse action, ECOA fair lending, and UDAAP concerns for AI-driven financial decisions.
items.label: CFPB

items.title: FCRA / ECOA
items.description: Adverse action reasons and fair lending compliance for SF's consumer credit AI — SHAP-based reason code generation and disparate impact testing are standard for all ClickMasters consumer credit AI in San Francisco.
items.label: FCRA · ECOA

items.title: CCPA / CPRA
items.description: Consumer financial data used in AI applications must comply with CCPA's expanded consumer rights — ClickMasters designs SF FinTech AI with California consumer privacy compliance in mind.
items.label: CCPA · CPRA

sections.note: Definitive regulatory compliance determinations require qualified California financial services and regulatory legal counsel. ClickMasters provides technical implementation and documentation.
